'''''Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded''''' is a [[canon]] reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published by [[Dorling Kindersley]] on [[April 5]], [[2016]]. It is a follow-up to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference title ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''. Content from the expanded version was reissued in the [[2017]] compendium [[Star Wars: I Want to Be a Jedi (2017)|''Star Wars: I Want to Be a Jedi'']].

==Publisher's summary==
''Updated and expanded with amazing new material including characters from ''Star Wars™: The Force Awakens''!

Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded'', the definitive guide to the people, aliens, and droids of the ''Star Wars'' galaxy, is back, bigger and better than ever before, and packed with new ''Star Wars'' characters!''

''Want to know how tall Darth Vader is? Or where the ferocious Nexu comes from? Look no further than the ''Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded''. With more than 200 profiles on heroes, villains, and more, this handy guide is full of fun facts and intriguing information guaranteed to enthrall fans for hours on end.''

==Development==
Several of the original book entries have been removed to make place for the new ones. The entries for [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Baron Papanoida]], [[Bultar Swan]], [[Chi Eekway Papanoida]], [[Cin Drallig]], [[Elan Sel'Sabagno|Elan Sleazebaggano]], [[Sim Aloo|Imperial Dignitary]], [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], [[GH-7 series medical assistance droid|GH-7 Medical Droid]], [[Jocasta Nu]], [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], [[OOM-9]], [[Passel Argente]], [[Pau'an]] Warrior, [[FA-4 pilot droid|Pilot Droid]], [[Rune Haako]], [[Saelt-Marae]], [[San Hill]], [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]], [[Ten Numb]] and [[Yuzzum]] were removed. The [[Mustafarian]] (Northern / Southern) was merged into one single entry like the [[Colo claw fish|Colo Claw Fish]], the [[Opee sea killer|Opee Sea Killer]] and the [[Sando aqua monster|Sando Aqua Monster]] entry.

==Continuity==
*[[Adi Gallia]]'s [[homeworld]] is listed as [[Coruscant]] like in ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="SW:AEYNtK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> However, ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' listed her homeworld as [[Tholoth]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref>
*[[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa's]] height is given as 1.91 [[meter]]s. However, Organa's [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry lists it as 1.99 meters.<ref name="Databank Organa">{{Databank|bail-organa|Bail Organa}}</ref>
*Though [[Cornelius Evazan]] is described as having survived his encounter with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], the Databank entries of both Evazan<ref name="Databank Evazan">{{Databank|doctor-cornelius-evazan|Doctor Cornelius Evazan}}</ref> and [[Ponda Baba]]<ref name="Databank Baba">{{Databank|ponda-baba|Ponda Baba}}</ref> claim that he [[Death|died]]. However, the short story "[[The Secrets of Long Snoot]]" from the [[2017]] anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'' also stated that Evazan indeed survived.<ref name="The Kloo Horn Cantina Caper">{{StoryCite|story=The Kloo Horn Cantina Caper|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>
*While [[Maz Kanata]]'s homeworld is given as [[Takodana]], the [[2019]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' established that Kanata's homeworld is unknown.<ref name="IX Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*[[Finis Valorum]]'s height is given as 1.7 meters. However, Valorum's Databank entry lists it as 1.83 meters.<ref name="Databank Valorum">{{Databank|supreme-chancellor-valorum|Supreme Chancellor Valorum}}</ref>
